goal: Generate a gift set display image that combines a festive feel with product readability, clearly presenting the outer box, inserts, and contents all on one screen.

package.type: Rigid flip-top gift box, with the cover opening at 75° angled, with a shallow groove inside.
package.shape: Flat rectangular block, long edge slightly showing diagonal perspective to the viewer.
package.exterior_color: Matte Chinese red, front embossed gold brand words 'Starbucks China · Winter Gifts' with snowflake geometric patterns
package.interior_color: Creamy white flocked material + dark green border line at the bottom of the inner box.
package.logo: Classic Green Octagonal Mermaid Logo Foil Stamped in Gold at Top Left of Box
package.ribbon: Deep green velvet bow pressed on one side of the outer cover, not fully untied

items: Two bags of 250g single-origin coffee beans, kraft paper stand-up bags, gold-foiled product names, placed side by side at an angle.
A ceramic mug with embossed snowflakes and a gold-rimmed cup edge leaning against a plush groove
One Starbucks star gift card, gold background with green pattern, partially inserted paper card
Folded brewing recommendation booklet, revealing an illustrated corner
contents.arrangement: Coffee bag on the left, mug on the right, gift card and brochure in the foreground do not obstruct the logo

scene.background_surface: Warm white marble-patterned countertop, forming high contrast with the red box but not overexposed
scene.background_color_tone: Creamy white, dark green, gold, and Christmas red.
extra_decorations: A very small amount of gold powder pine needles outside the bottom edge of the image, not entering the box.

lighting.key_light: High side soft light, gold foil has a clear highlight streak
lighting.fill_light: Front-side fill light, flocking retains details

text_overlay.headline: Share the first cup of seasonal aroma with important people
text_overlay.subline: 2026 Winter Joy limited gift · available in-store and through Dedicated Star Delivery
text_overlay.position: In the lower left of the image, vertically aligned small text that does not compete with the main visual.

style.rendering: High-quality studio lighting for e-commerce hero and poster use
style.consistency: Red, Green, Gold as Primary Colors, No Mixed Colors

must_keep: Gold foil is readable under soft light, not overexposed to a white board
Lining and contents are positioned without any reveals
avoid: Christmas Elements Too Dense Turned into Grocery Store
